title: L1A Progress
description: The entire learner state. Lives in localStorage under the key l1a.progress and is the exact shape written to and read from the export/import JSON file - one format, so an export is a real backup. Every read and write is wrapped in try/catch; a record that fails validation is kept aside rather than overwritten. Single user, on-device only: no accounts, no sync (decisions.md).

export_version.description: Format version of this file. Import refuses a version it does not know rather than guessing at a migration.

exported_at.description: Set only when written to a file, never in localStorage. ISO 8601.

updated_at.description: Last time any part of this record changed. ISO 8601. Import compares this against the in-browser copy before replacing anything.

concepts.description: Per-concept state, keyed by concept ID. A concept is complete when it has been viewed in at least one mode and its lesson check is at or above pass (master-plan 8).

modes_viewed.description: Which of the 8 modes have been opened. Presence of a true flag is what satisfies the 'viewed in at least one mode' half of lesson completion; it also drives the 'you have not tried this way yet' nudge.

complete.description: Derived: viewed in a mode plus lesson check at or above pass. Stored so the Ladder renders without recomputing the whole tree.

focus.description: On the Focus List - missed questions have flagged this as a weak spot. Reshapes the daily plan.

modules.description: Per-module state, keyed by module ID. Module complete = all lessons complete plus a module exam at or above pass.

exam_attempts.description: Every module exam sitting, oldest first. Kept in full: the retake rule needs the timestamp of the last attempt, and the trend charts need the rest.

by_domain.description: Score per domain, for the familiar score-report breakdown and the heat map.

question_ids.description: What was served, so a retake can draw a fresh set.

retake_available_at.description: End of the review period after a failed attempt.

srs.description: Spaced-repetition state, keyed by card ID. SM-2 shaped: a card graded again drops back to a short interval, anything else lengthens it by ease.

interval_days.description: Current interval. 0 = new or relearning, due today.

ease.description: SM-2 ease factor. Starts at 2.5 and floors at 1.3.

due.description: Next review date, YYYY-MM-DD. Anything at or before today is in the daily plan.

last_result.description: How the last review was graded.

confidence.description: Self-rated on the last review. A right answer tagged 'guessed' still comes back soon - that is the point of tagging it.

reps.description: Successful reviews in the current streak. Resets on 'again'.

lapses.description: Lifetime count of 'again' grades. A high count marks a leech for the Focus List.

tiers.description: One entry per rung. Gating is enforced here and re-checked in code: Fire opens on EMT complete, Paramedic on Fire complete. A locked tier is still browsable.

exam_date.description: Target exam date set at onboarding, used to pace the daily plan.

streak.description: Shifts worked, not a guilt counter.

status.description: locked = prerequisite rung not finished, browsable but not openable. unlocked = in progress. complete = all modules plus two full simulations at or above 85 and tier card retention at or above 90.

readiness.description: The 0-100 Exam Readiness meter: module exam scores, card retention and full-simulation results. Turns green when statistically ready.

card_retention_pct.description: Retention across the tier deck. Part of the tier-completion gate.

simulations.description: Full-length practice exams. Tier completion needs two at or above 85.

skills_reviewed.description: Psychomotor skill checklists reviewed, part of the tier gate.

self_attest.description: The 'I'm already certified' override. Unlocks this tier without completing the one below it - keeps the ladder honest without punishing someone who already climbed a rung elsewhere. Single user, so this is an honour-system record, not a verification.

credential.description: What is being attested to, in the learner's own words.
